profile.name: Juan Manuel Ibáñez
profile.headline: Frontend Engineer
about: Frontend Engineer with 7+ years building React/TypeScript products for US and European clients across healthtech, e-commerce and travel. I've owned payment, compliance and analytics features end-to-end, driven design-system and build-tool migrations, and led code reviews focused on type safety and hook correctness.

I have a track record building multi-brand component architectures — a shared library serving five Gap Inc. brands and a React Native codebase powering three branded mental-health apps — with a strong focus on accessibility and testing.

Before software, I was an Electronics Engineer (UTN) working with medical imaging and radiotherapy equipment, and I hold an MBA. Today I build agentic AI workflows with the Claude API and MCP — this site was delivered by a 5-agent, spec- and test-driven development system I designed.
